# mas-web-components Implementation Expertise
# Adobe Commerce web components: pricing, checkout, and AEM fragment hydration
#
# USAGE: This file is the mental model for all mas-web-components tasks.
# Every file path, function name, and pattern must be verified against the real codebase.
# Run /mental-model:mas-web-components:self-improve after any mas-web-components changes.

overview:
  description: "Published npm library (@adobecom/mas v0.6.0) of Lit + vanilla web components for Adobe's commerce UI: inline prices, checkout links/buttons, and merch cards backed by WCS pricing and AEM Content Fragments."
  core_insight: "The commerce service (`<mas-commerce-service>`) is the singleton orchestrator — it bootstraps WCS, IMS, Price, Checkout, and Defaults before any component can render. All components use `getService()` to access the resolved service instance."
  architecture_pattern: "Custom Elements + Lit; components are self-registering via `customElements.define`. AEM fragment data flows in via `<aem-fragment>`, then components hydrate themselves from that data."
  value_proposition:
    - "Standalone: works in any page — no framework dependency except Lit for merch-card"
    - "WCS-backed: all prices fetched from Adobe's Web Commerce Service with batching and caching"
    - "IMS-aware: surfaces signed-in country for tax calculations, but degrades gracefully when IMS unavailable"
    - "Fragment-driven: card content sourced from AEM Content Fragments via mas.js IO integration"

# ─── KEY FILES ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

key_files:
  orchestration:
    mas-commerce-service:
      file: "apps/mas/web-components/src/mas-commerce-service.js"
      purpose: "Root custom element that bootstraps all services. Must be present in DOM before any commerce element renders."
      key_classes:
        MasCommerceService: "Extends HTMLElement. Reads env/locale/country/wcs-api-key attributes. Calls Wcs(), Ims(), Price(), Checkout(), Defaults(). Dispatches EVENT_TYPE_READY when ready."
      key_functions:
        registerCheckoutAction: "Allows host page to override checkout behavior (e.g., open modal instead of navigating)"

    mas-element:
      file: "apps/mas/web-components/src/mas-element.js"
      purpose: "Base class for all price/checkout elements. Manages lifecycle, service resolution, and state."
      key_classes:
        MasElement: "Base class — handles connected/disconnected, attribute change → re-render"
      key_functions:
        createMasElement: "Factory to instantiate typed MasElement subclasses"

  pricing:
    inline-price:
      file: "apps/mas/web-components/src/inline-price.js"
      purpose: "Renders formatted price text inline. Resolves offer via WCS, applies locale tax rules."
      key_functions:
        resolvePriceTaxFlags: "Determines displayTax based on country + segment. Called from mas-commerce-service."

    price:
      file: "apps/mas/web-components/src/price.js"
      purpose: "Price formatting and rendering logic. Wraps tacocat-core price utilities."

    literals:
      file: "apps/mas/web-components/src/literals.js"
      purpose: "Price literal strings (recurrence, per-unit, tax labels) per locale."
      key_functions:
        getPriceLiterals: "Returns locale-aware literal strings for price display"

  checkout:
    checkout-link:
      file: "apps/mas/web-components/src/checkout-link.js"
      purpose: "Anchor element (`<a is='checkout-link'>`) that generates checkout URLs."
      key_classes:
        CheckoutLink: "Extends CheckoutMixin(HTMLAnchorElement). Uses `extends` pattern (customized built-in element)."

# mas-io Implementation Expertise
# Adobe I/O Runtime serverless actions for Merch at Scale
#
# USAGE: This file is the mental model for all mas-io tasks.
# Run /mental-model:mas-io:self-improve after any changes to apps/mas/io/.
#
# UPSTREAM CONTRACTS: mas-web-components — Offer data shape, fragment schema,
# WCS API contract, OSI identifiers. See mas-web-components/expertise.yaml.

overview:
  description: "Two AIO Runtime OpenWhisk apps: io/www (fragment delivery pipeline with transformer chain) and io/studio (studio backend: OST products, member management, translation). Both run Node.js 22 on Adobe I/O Runtime."
  core_insight: "io/www is a pure data pipeline — requests flow through a sequential PIPELINE[] of transformer functions, each mutating a shared context object. io/studio is a CRUD backend for Studio authoring operations, using Odin (AEM API) for fragment writes."
  architecture_pattern: "OpenWhisk web actions. Each action is an async main(params) function. Params include __ow_headers (HTTP headers), __ow_body, and action-specific env inputs. State is managed via @adobe/aio-lib-state."
  value_proposition:
    - "io/www: Serves fragment JSON to merch-card components with WCS price injection and promotion overlays"
    - "io/studio: Provides authenticated Studio operations (member CRUD, OST product sync, translation project creation)"
    - "Separate deployable units: io/www and io/studio have independent deploy pipelines and env vars"

# ─── KEY FILES ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

key_files:
  io_www:
    app_config:
      file: "apps/mas/io/www/app.config.yaml"
      purpose: "AIO app manifest. Defines MerchAtScale package with fragment and health-check actions."
      actions:
        fragment: "src/fragment/pipeline.js — web:yes, require-adobe-auth:false"
        health_check: "src/health-check/index.js — checks ODIN and WCS endpoint health"
      env_inputs:
        - "ODIN_CDN_ENDPOINT — Odin CDN URL"
        - "ODIN_ORIGIN_ENDPOINT — Odin origin URL"
        - "WCS_CDN_ENDPOINT — WCS CDN URL"
        - "WCS_ORIGIN_ENDPOINT — WCS origin URL"

    pipeline:
      file: "apps/mas/io/www/src/fragment/pipeline.js"
      purpose: "Main action entry point. Runs fragment data through a sequential transformer chain."
      key_constants:
        PIPELINE: "[fetchFragment, promotions, customize, settings, replace, wcs, corrector]"
        CONFIG_CACHE_TTL: "5 minutes — configuration cache duration"
        RESPONSE_HEADERS: "Content-Type:application/json, Content-Encoding:br (brotli), CORS expose headers"
      key_functions:
        main: "async main(params) — OpenWhisk action entry. Builds context, runs PIPELINE, returns brotli-compressed JSON."
        calculateHash: "SHA-256 hash of request body for cache key"
      key_pattern: "context object passed by reference through each transformer; transformers mutate context.response"
      state: "Uses @adobe/aio-lib-state for request metadata caching (stateLib.init())"

    transformers:
      directory: "apps/mas/io/www/src/fragment/transformers/"
      files:
        fetchFragment: "apps/mas/io/www/src/fragment/transformers/fetchFragment.js — fetches AEM fragment JSON from Odin CDN/origin"
        promotions: "apps/mas/io/www/src/fragment/transformers/promotions.js — overlays promotion data onto fragment"
        customize: "apps/mas/io/www/src/fragment/transformers/customize.js — applies customization rules"
        settings: "apps/mas/io/www/src/fragment/transformers/settings.js — injects settings/config into context"
        replace: "apps/mas/io/www/src/fragment/transformers/replace.js — field value replacements"
        wcs: "apps/mas/io/www/src/fragment/transformers/wcs.js — fetches WCS price data, injects into fragment"
        corrector: "apps/mas/io/www/src/fragment/transformers/corrector.js — final cleanup/correction pass"
      pattern: "Each transformer exports: { transformer: async function(context) { ... } }. Mutates context in place."

    pipeline_utils:

# mas-studio Implementation Expertise
# Merch at Scale Studio — Lit-based authoring UI for AEM Content Fragments
#
# USAGE: This file is the mental model for all mas-studio tasks.
# Run /mental-model:mas-studio:self-improve after any changes to apps/mas/studio/src/.
#
# UPSTREAM CONTRACTS:
# - mas-web-components: Fragment field schema, variant names, merch-card web component API
# - mas-io: io/studio action endpoints (members, OST products, translation)

overview:
  description: "Lit-based web component UI for authoring Merch at Scale content. Connects to AEM Cloud (author environment) via a local CORS proxy to read/write Content Fragments. Renders live merch-card previews alongside the editor."
  core_insight: "Studio is a pure UI layer over the AEM CF REST API. The AEM class (aem.js) wraps all AEM API calls. Fragment class is the client-side model. Reactivity uses a Lit-compatible reactive store pattern (store.js + reactivity/)."
  architecture_pattern: "Lit web components + Spectrum Web Components UI. LitElement editors per content model. Local proxy-server.mjs (port 3100) forwards to AEM Cloud with CORS headers injected."
  value_proposition:
    - "Inline editing: authors edit fragment fields in a side panel while seeing live merch-card preview"
    - "Multi-model support: merch-card, merch-card-collection, compare-chart each have dedicated editors"
    - "AEM-backed: all reads/writes go through AEM CF REST API (search, CRUD, publish, tag filter)"

# ─── KEY FILES ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

key_files:
  entry:
    index:
      file: "apps/mas/studio/src/index.js"
      purpose: "Library entry point. Imports mnemonic field and multifield, re-exports from studio.js."
    studio_html:
      file: "apps/mas/studio.html"
      purpose: "Standalone Studio app page. Loaded in browser for authoring."

  aem_layer:
    aem:
      file: "apps/mas/studio/src/aem/aem.js"
      purpose: "AEM CF REST API client. All HTTP calls to AEM go through this class."
      key_classes:
        AEM: |
          constructor(bucket, baseUrlOverride)
          this.cfFragmentsUrl = '{baseUrl}/adobe/sites/cf/fragments'
          this.cfSearchUrl — fragment search endpoint
          this.cfPublishUrl — fragment publish endpoint
          this.cfReferencedByUrl — find fragments referencing this one
          this.wcmcommandUrl — page activation commands
          this.csrfTokenUrl — CSRF token for write operations
          filterByTags(tags) — tag filter with OR within root, AND between roots

    fragment:
      file: "apps/mas/studio/src/aem/fragment.js"
      purpose: "Client-side Fragment model wrapping AEM CF JSON."
      key_classes:
        Fragment: |
          constructor(fragment) — wraps AEM CF JSON
          getField(fieldName) → field object
          getFieldValues(fieldName) → values[]
          getFieldValue(fieldName, index?) → single value
          variant (getter) — reads 'variant' field
          fragmentName (getter) — last path segment
          locale (getter) — parsed from path using PATH_TOKENS regex
          isValueEmpty(values) → boolean
          hasChanges — dirty flag for unsaved edits

gotchas:
  - "checkout-link uses customized built-in elements (extends HTMLAnchorElement) — Safari requires a polyfill; this is NOT a standard LitElement."
  - "mas-commerce-service MUST be in DOM before any commerce component. Components that mount before the service will wait for EVENT_TYPE_READY but may time out (20s timeout in merch-card)."
  - "wcsApiKey default is 'wcms-commerce-ims-ro-user-milo' — changing it changes which WCS surface is queried. Surface names like 'CreativeCloud_*' determine preview surface in settings.js."
  - "The internal/ directory contains vendored tarballs (tacocat-core, fetch, logger, data-models). These are NOT on npm — installed via file: protocol in package.json."
  - "Build output is dist/mas.js (ESM). Consumers import from this file, NOT from src/. Never import src/ files directly in production."
  - "IMS polling has a 25-attempt limit (5s total). After that, imsReady resolves anyway — components must handle null imsCountry."
  - "Tax display has 50+ locale exceptions hard-coded in inline-price.js (DISPLAY_ALL_TAX_COUNTRIES). Adding a new locale requires updating this list."
  - "EVENT_TYPE_READY vs EVENT_MAS_READY: the service dispatches EVENT_TYPE_READY; each merch-card dispatches EVENT_MAS_READY. They are different events."

# ─── BEST PRACTICES ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

best_practices:
  - "Always place <mas-commerce-service> as early as possible in the document to minimize time-to-price."
  - "Use getService() (from utilities.js) to access the singleton — do not query the DOM directly for mas-commerce-service."
  - "When adding a new variant to merch-card, register it in variants/variants.js via registerVariant() and add a fragment mapping."
  - "Run `npm run build:bundle` (not just `npm run build`) during development to avoid running the full test suite on every change."
  - "Use `node ./watch.mjs --serve` (or `just start`) for local dev — it builds and serves with hot reload on port 3200."

# ─── KEY FILE LOCATIONS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    service: "apps/mas/web-components/src/mas-commerce-service.js"
    base_element: "apps/mas/web-components/src/mas-element.js"

    output: "apps/mas/web-components/dist/mas.js"

gotchas:
  - "io/www and io/studio are SEPARATE AIO apps with separate app.config.yaml, separate deploy commands, and separate env vars. Running aio app deploy in io/www does NOT deploy io/studio."
  - "PIPELINE order matters — wcs.js runs AFTER promotions and customize because it needs the resolved fragment fields to know which OSIs to look up."
  - "require-adobe-auth: false means the Runtime validates nothing — actions must validate allowedClientId themselves if auth is needed."
  - "context.state must be initialized before transformers run: context.state = await stateLib.init(). If the action cold-starts, stateLib.init() can add ~200ms."
  - "Brotli Content-Encoding on io/www responses — clients must decompress. Consumers (merch-card) must handle br encoding."
  - "Translation mapping is hardcoded in app.config.yaml inputs — adding a new surface (e.g. 'ccd') requires a deploy, not just a config change."
  - "postToOdinWithRetry's exponential backoff caps at 5000ms per attempt. With 3 retries and 429s from Odin, total wait can reach 8+ seconds."
  - "updateMembers has require-adobe-auth: true AND final: false — meaning it can be chained. Other studio actions have final: true, so they cannot be chained."

# ─── BEST PRACTICES ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

best_practices:
  - "When adding a new transformer to PIPELINE, add it in the correct order — after any data it depends on, before any data that depends on it."
  - "Log with requestId in every transformer: log('message', context) — context contains requestId for request tracing."
  - "For new studio actions: add to app.config.yaml with explicit require-adobe-auth and final annotations. Never leave these implicit."
  - "Use `npm run test:ci` in each io directory before PRs — CI rejects without passing tests."
  - "Env vars in app.config.yaml use $VAR_NAME syntax — must be in .env file (or GitHub secrets) before deploy."
